name: cross-repo-patch-suite
summary: Keep patches byte-faithful across repositories — appends that never rewrite existing bytes, CRLF/EOL fidelity, parseable workflow YAML, and SHA-pinned action references.

sub_skills.title: Byte-exact append
sub_skills.summary: Append to a file without decoding it, matching the target's line endings so the diff shows only the new lines.

sub_skills.title: Line-ending fidelity
sub_skills.summary: Detect LF/CRLF/CR/mixed, find the CRLF-without-trailing-newline combination that breaks `git am`, and rewrite endings without touching content.

sub_skills.title: Patch apply and diagnosis
sub_skills.summary: Run `git apply` / `git am` and turn the single unhelpful 'does not apply' message into a named cause and a fix.

sub_skills.title: Workflow YAML and SHA-pin gate
sub_skills.summary: Validate workflow YAML before pushing, locate unquoted-colon ScannerErrors by line and column, and audit every `uses:` reference for a full-SHA pin.

sub_skills.title: Overwrite guard
sub_skills.summary: Refuse a create over an existing file and require exact-path approval for a replace, so new work is written beside existing work rather than on top of it.

sub_skills.title: Credential-constrained handoff
sub_skills.summary: When the app token cannot push to .github/workflows/, ship a verified patch plus a handoff document instead of failing silently.
